subject: KVPro int4_protected + prot-int8 sidecar vs Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 architecture
method: Static code inspection of the KVPro harness (no model loaded). Labels: INFERRED unless noted.

harness_architecture_generality.rope_capture: capture_kv.py patches transformers.models.<model_type>.modeling_<model_type>.apply_rotary_pos_emb dynamically (:60-69) -> works for model_type='mistral' provided that symbol exists in the installed transformers version (VERIFY ON POD).
harness_architecture_generality.kv_layout_read: fakequant_model.layer_kv handles transformers 5.x .layers[i].keys/.values, legacy key_cache[i], and tuple layouts -> Mistral DynamicCache compatible.
harness_architecture_generality.geometry_source: calibrate_mask_hf.py reads num_kv_heads/head_dim/num_layers from model.config generically (:88,107) -> no hard-coded Qwen geometry.

head_dim.note: phase5b_4c_paged_writer + prot_int8 constants assume D=128; Mistral head_dim=128 matches (same as Qwen2.5-7B).

gqa_kv_heads.note: GQA with 8 KV heads is within the already-exercised range.

rope.kvpro: standard Llama-style rotary via apply_rotary_pos_emb patch
rope.status: COMPATIBLE (INFERRED) — verify apply_rotary_pos_emb signature on the installed transformers

sliding_window_attention.kvpro_assumption: FULL causal attention over the whole paged KV cache; the int4_protected paged writer/kernel has no sliding-window masking.
sliding_window_attention.mistral_v0_3: sliding_window = null (SWA DISABLED) -> full attention -> COMPATIBLE
sliding_window_attention.mistral_v0_1_v0_2: sliding_window = 4096 (SWA ENABLED) -> INCOMPATIBLE without SWA handling — DO NOT USE these for this study
sliding_window_attention.status: COMPATIBLE for v0.3 ONLY, CONDITIONAL ON config.json sliding_window==null — VERIFY ON POD before running.

protect_fraction.status: same n_protect as Qwen2.5-7B; prot_int8 constants shapes unaffected

prot_int8_requirement.needs: v2 mask artifact WITH per-channel k_min/k_max (Phase-6N). Build with calibrate_phase5b_protect_mask.py (emits artifact_version=2, k_min/k_max). The plain calibrate_mask_hf.py may not emit minmax.
prot_int8_requirement.consumed_by: fakequant_model.py:77-82 (P8prod cell) passes k_min/k_max into reconstruct_p8; production writer loads them via load_protect_minmax_for_layer.

path_classifications.quality_ABC_fakequant: run_p8_quality.sh cells fp/affine/P8prod use quantizers.reconstruct + reconstruct_p8 then run HF attention on reconstructed K. This is a FAKE-QUANT reference path, apples-to-apples for C-B (identical machinery, only prot dtype differs), but NOT the production vLLM int4 kernel. Label any result from it TEST-BACKED/MEASURED-fakequant, never 'production'.
path_classifications.production_decode: External forked-vLLM flash_attn_with_int4_kvcache; needs the pod's patched vLLM built for Mistral geometry. Consumes bf16 protected sidecar (int8 is dequantized to bf16 before the kernel). VERIFY the fork supports num_kv_heads=8/head_dim=128 on the pod.

verdict: COMPATIBLE for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (fake-quant quality path) CONDITIONAL ON: (1) config.json sliding_window==null, (2) apply_rotary_pos_emb present for model_type 'mistral' in the installed transformers, (3) a v2 k_min/k_max mask built for Mistral. Production-kernel compatibility is INFERRED and must be verified against the pod's vLLM fork.
